verification.method: scripts/verify/ethiopia.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank 2026/2050/2100, share, growth, density, land area; second in Africa after Nigeria; larger every year 1950–2100
Yearly addition (fifth in the world after India, Nigeria, Pakistan, DR Congo), births, deaths, small migration; almost eightfold since 1950; doubling by 2066
Urban share 1950/2026/2050, sixth-lowest among countries over 10 million
Fertility 1984 peak, now, under 2.1 only from 2075; median age; life expectancy 1950 and now
7th in the world in 2050 and 2100; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 59 of 59 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name their size group and region; no causes are stated that the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
